name: The Superette
summary: The Superette is a contemporary retail destination in Boston's thriving Seaport District, serving the area's affluent urban professionals and residents. Located at 131 Seaport Boulevard, it offers a curated mix of retailers and services in one of Boston's most dynamic waterfront neighborhoods.
demographics: The Superette attracts a young, affluent demographic typical of Boston's Seaport District, with visitors primarily aged 25-45 working in nearby tech, finance, and professional services firms. The trade area serves high-income urban professionals and residents of luxury Seaport condominiums, with household incomes significantly above the Boston metro average. Shoppers exhibit preferences for convenience-oriented retail, quick-service dining, and experiential offerings that complement the district's modern, walkable urban environment.
description: The Superette represents a modern retail concept in Boston's rapidly transformed Seaport District, one of the city's most dynamic waterfront neighborhoods. Located at 131 Seaport Boulevard, this contemporary shopping destination serves the area's growing population of young professionals, tech workers, and luxury condominium residents. The center embodies the Seaport's evolution from industrial waterfront to a vibrant mixed-use district, offering a curated selection of retailers and services tailored to urban lifestyles. With its prime location along Seaport Boulevard, The Superette benefits from exceptional foot traffic generated by nearby office towers, residential developments, and the district's numerous restaurants and entertainment venues. The center's modern design and tenant mix reflect the sophisticated tastes of Boston's Seaport community, making it an integral part of the neighborhood's retail ecosystem.
